system.name: SNIP
system.one_liner: an adaptive mixed-precision training framework that periodically re-solves per-layer subbyte precision for LLM pretraining

components.name: Fwd Bwd
components.role: standard forward/backward training iteration running continuously along the timeline

components.name: 1.Collect Statistics
components.role: periodically collects statistics on activations, weights, and optimizer states

components.name: 2. Analyze Divergence
components.role: analyzes the collected statistics to estimate precision-loss impact

components.name: 3. Solve ILP
components.role: formulates and solves an Integer Linear Programming problem to pick optimal per-layer precision

components.name: 4. Update New Model Precision
components.role: asynchronously applies the newly computed layer-wise quantization assignment

components.name: Old Model Precision
components.role: the model's per-layer (L0-L3) precision before this update round

components.name: New Model Precision
components.role: the model's per-layer (L0-L3) precision after applying the ILP solution, mixing FP8 and FP4

flows.what: reassigned layer precisions (e.g., L2 from FP8 to FP4)

summary: SNIP is a fine-grained adaptive mixed-precision training framework for LLM pretraining that supports subbyte precision. Figure 2 gives a system-level view of how SNIP integrates into a standard training loop: along a timeline of repeating forward/backward (Fwd Bwd) iterations, SNIP periodically and asynchronously runs four numbered steps -- collecting statistics on activations, weights and optimizer states, analyzing divergence metrics, solving an ILP for optimal per-layer precision, and updating the model's quantization assignment. Below the timeline, two small per-layer (L0-L3) panels contrast the Old Model Precision against the New Model Precision, using pink boxes for FP8 layers and green boxes for FP4 layers, with a small legend giving the resulting 50% FP4/50% FP8 efficiency budget. The figure is a single-column pipeline diagram built from flat, rounded pastel boxes with thin arrows, emphasizing that SNIP's precision search runs alongside, not inside, the critical training path.
summary_zh: 该图展示 SNIP 系统如何嵌入 LLM 训练流程：在持续进行的前向/反向训练时间线旁，SNIP 周期性异步执行“收集统计-分析散度-求解ILP-更新精度”四步，并对比更新前后各层（L0-L3）精度（粉色为FP8，绿色为FP4）。
